hero_body: Kandel Strategies connects legal journalists with law firm partners and executives for expert media commentary. Founded by former journalist Jason Kandel, the firm guides attorneys through reporter interviews, manages litigation PR for high-profile court cases, and secures earned media placements across legal trades and national news outlets.
philosophy_quote: Kandel Strategies emphasizes authentic credibility, direct communication, and thorough groundwork over generic PR scripts or high-volume promotional noise. The firm combines veteran journalism experience with modern digital tools to deliver clear, factual media strategies for law firms, legal leaders, and corporate executives.

services.title: Communications
services.description: Clear, focused messaging that turns complex matters into jargon-free language and creates opportunities for attorneys and executives to share their expertise.

services.title: Media Relations
services.description: Direct outreach to reporters and newsrooms to secure earned coverage in mainstream media and legal trades.

services.title: AI Visibility
services.description: Structuring your public record, published work, and media coverage so tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google cite your expertise accurately.

about_text: My approach to legal PR is built on years inside major newsrooms, including the Los Angeles Times, NBC4 Los Angeles, Thomson Reuters, and LAist/KPCC (Southern California Public Radio). Having sat on the other side of the desk, I understand how editors make split-second decisions and what turns a lawyer into a go-to source. Now, I match journalists with attorneys who provide clear, authoritative commentary on major cases and breaking legal news.

faqs.question: What services does Kandel Strategies provide?
faqs.answer: Kandel Strategies specializes in public relations, crisis communications, and media strategy tailored specifically for attorneys, law firms, and legal organizations.

faqs.question: How does Kandel Strategies assist with litigation PR?
faqs.answer: I manage high-stakes media interest, draft clear press releases and statements, and protect client reputations during complex legal disputes and courtroom proceedings.

faqs.question: Where is Kandel Strategies located and who do you serve?
faqs.answer: Based in Southern California, Kandel Strategies serves law firms, corporate legal departments, and individual attorneys across California and nationwide.
